name: Yellow Mold
disable: DC 26 Survival check (expert) to remove the mold without triggering the spores

items.name: Spore Explosion
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves into the mold's space or damages the mold. The mold can't use this reaction if it's in direct sunlight or if the damage was fire damage.

---

Effect The triggering creature and all creatures within 10 feet are exposed to yellow mold spores.

items.name: Yellow Mold Spores
items.text:
Any drained condition from the spores persists after the poison's duration ends.

Saving Throw DC 26 Fortitude save

---

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d8 poison damage and Drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 2d8 poison damage and Drained 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 3d8 poison damage and Drained 3 (1 round)

text: Poisonous mold spores assault nearby creatures.
